ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_softplus_rank_loss
ir.intuition: Repaired the loss to replace the relu margin ranking with a softplus margin ranking loss that softly penalizes violations, reducing exact match with previous relu-based margin ranking losses and improving novelty. Instead of hard zeroing, softplus provides a smooth, differentiable approximation to the hinge loss, encouraging the model to rank log_prob_w higher than log_prob_l by at least the advantage_gap. This reduces clipping artifacts and makes the loss more stable, while still using only permitted ops and requiring the same observables, ensuring compliance with gates.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = advantage_gap
pred_margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss_per_pair = softplus(margin - pred_margin)
weighted_loss = weight * loss_per_pair
final_loss = mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    margin = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch['weight']

    pred_margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss_per_pair = ops.softplus(ops.sub(margin, pred_margin))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
